title: Anthropic raises an additional $12.2B as underwriters exercise their "greenshoe" overallotment of shares, bringing the total raised in its IPO to $93.5B (Ashley Capoot/CNBC)
summary: Ashley Capoot / CNBC: Anthropic raises an additional $12.2B as underwriters exercise their “greenshoe” overallotment of shares, bringing the total raised in its IPO to $93.5B — Anthropic underwriters have officially exercised their overallotment of shares in the historic initial public offering …
